terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content:
<title>1. Overview</title>
Pinksea is a digital content platform where users can purchase access to exclusive content. All content is AI-generated and owned by the platform. No subscriptions — just one-time payments to unlock content.

<title>2. Eligibility</title>
You must be 18 years or older to use Pinksea. By using the platform, you confirm that you meet this requirement.

<title>3. User Accounts</title>
You are responsible for your account credentials and activity.
Do not share your account or attempt to access another user’s account.
We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms.

<title>4. Creators and Content</title>
All content on Pinksea is created by AI models developed and managed by us. There are no user-submitted uploads or third-party creators.
By using Pinksea, you agree that:
- All models and content are fictional and AI-generated.
- Users cannot become creators or upload any content.
- All payments made on the platform go to the platform owner.

<title>5. Payments and Refunds</title>
Access to content is granted via one-time payments.
All payments are final and non-refundable.
Payment processing is handled by third-party providers.

<title>6. Intellectual Property</title>
All content, branding, and technology on Pinksea are owned by us or licensed to us. Users may not reproduce, distribute, or modify any content.

<title>7. Prohibited Conduct</title>
You agree not to:
- Copy, distribute, or resell any content
- Attempt to reverse engineer or misuse the platform
- Violate any applicable laws while using Pinksea

<title>8. Termination</title>
We may suspend or terminate your access at any time if you breach these Terms or for any other operational or legal reason.

<title>9. Disclaimers</title>
The platform is provided “as is.” We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted or error-free.
Content may depict fictional characters, themes, or scenarios that do not reflect reality.

<title>10. Limitation of Liability</title>
To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages related to your use of Pinksea.

<title>11. Modifications</title>
We may update these Terms at any time. Continued use of the platform means you accept the revised Terms.

<title>12. Governing Law</title>
These Terms are governed by the laws of Switzerland. Any disputes will be handled by the competent courts in Switzerland.

<title>13. Contact</title>
Email: admin@pinksea.app
Location: Switzerland

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
<title>1. Introduction</title>
This Privacy Policy explains how Pinksea collects, uses, stores, and protects your personal data. By using the platform, you agree to this policy.

<title>2. Data Controller</title>
Pinksea is operated from Switzerland and acts as the data controller under Swiss data protection laws (nFADP).

<title>3. Data We Collect</title>
We may collect the following information:
- Email address
- Payment details (handled via third-party processors)
- Usage data (pages visited, interactions)
- IP address and device/browser information

<title>4. How We Use Your Data</title>
We use your data to:
- Provide access to purchased content
- Ensure platform security and prevent abuse
- Improve our services
- Comply with legal obligations

<title>5. Cookies and Tracking</title>
We may use cookies and analytics tools to understand usage patterns and improve the platform. You can control cookie settings via your browser.

<title>6. Data Sharing</title>
We do not sell your personal data.
We only share data with:
- Payment providers
- Service providers under confidentiality agreements
- Authorities when legally required

<title>7. Data Storage</title>
Data is stored securely in Switzerland or the EU. We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data.

<title>8. Data Retention</title>
We retain your data only as long as necessary for the purposes listed above or as required by law.

<title>9. Your Rights</title>
Under Swiss data protection law, you have the right to:
- Access your data
- Correct or delete inaccurate data
- Object to or restrict processing
- Withdraw consent
Contact us at admin@pinksea.app to exercise your rights.

<title>10. International Transfers</title>
If data is transferred outside Switzerland or the EU, we ensure legal safeguards such as standard contractual clauses are in place.

<title>11. Changes to This Policy</title>
We may update this Privacy Policy. Continued use of the platform means you accept the updated policy.

<title>12. Contact</title>
If you have questions about this policy, contact:
Email: admin@pinksea.app
Location: Switzerland
